summary: Verified frontend fixes for (1) Core Engine disease loading and (2) Body Map anatomical organ positions on /dashboard, /food, and /drugs pages. All target features work correctly on preview.

verifications.core_engine_diseases: PASS - '2498 diseases' badge visible in Find Condition panel; category tabs (Cardiac, Resp, Meta, Neuro, Other) render with per-subcategory counts (Ischemic/CAD 28, Cardiomyopathies 8, Valvular 23, Arrhythmias 21, Heart Failure 6, Hypertensive 16, Pericardial 9, Other Cardiac 203).
verifications.body_map_positions_drugs: PASS - Captopril Body Map SVG circles: brain cx=100 cy=35, heart cx=105 cy=100 (patient's left), lungs paired cx=70/130, liver cx=75 cy=135 (viewer left = patient's RIGHT), kidneys paired cx=75/125, pancreas cx=100 cy=145, stomach cx=115 cy=130 (viewer right = patient's LEFT), spleen cx=130 cy=140 (patient's LEFT), intestines cx=100 cy=180. All anatomically correct.
verifications.body_map_positions_food: PASS - Banana Body Map on /food shows identical anatomically correct positions after selecting food and clicking Body Map tab.
verifications.body_map_tab_navigation: PASS - Body Map tab present and clickable on both /food (after selecting food) and /drugs (after selecting drug).

action_items: User's original 'diseases not loading' report was on production. Preview works correctly (2498 diseases). Main agent should trigger a production redeploy to propagate the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: EnhancedBodyMap.js organ positions are now anatomically correct with clear inline comments explaining viewer-vs-patient orientation.
DashboardMultiScale.js is very large (>2900 lines) - consider splitting into smaller modules for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs are fixed on preview. Body map organ positions verified via SVG circle cx/cy attributes matching spec (liver cx=75 patient-right, stomach cx=115 patient-left, spleen cx=130 patient-left, heart cx=105 slightly-left). Disease count 2498 with categories. If user still reports issues, it's a production deploy lag.
